annotations.title: Bundle of cards (paid, cheaper than singly)

description: Paid USDC on Base. Call when you need every card in a set at once (chips filings, major central banks, BRICS central banks), cheaper than buying them singly. Same JSON as the single cards. Ids, prices and contents follow (also in list_filers). Bundles: SEMIS ($0.06: AMD, MRVL, NVDA, AVGO, TSM, MU, AMAT, INTC, ASML); CENTRALBANKS ($0.08: BOE, FED, ECB, BOJ, RBA, BOC, SNB); BRICS ($0.08: BCB, IND, ZAF, CHN, RUS, IDN, ETH, EGY, IRN). Others return 404 (no charge).
